pages.text: Your first block, made in an ordinary crafting table: 4 $(item)Iron Ingots$(), 4 $(item)Copper Ingots$(), $(item)Crafting Table$().$(br2)The $(item)Extreme Assembly Table$() is a $(thing)9x9$() crafting grid, and a normal crafting table as well.

$(l)The 9x9 rule$(): almost every recipe of this mod is made here, filling the whole 9x9 grid - what would be one ingredient in a 3x3 recipe is a $(thing)3x3 block of nine$() of it. So "a furnace in the middle" means nine furnaces in the middle block. Only the Codex itself and this table are made in a normal 3x3 crafting grid (and decorative blocks in a stonecutter).$(br2)The recipe pages of every entry draw the full 9x9 pattern; JEI or EMI show it too.
